settings.title: Korean CarPlay turn-by-turn on the cluster and HUD
settings.description: Korea Projection's fit, beside the official Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto mod (keep its Turn-by-turn on): an arrow for every maneuver, the near-turn view and distance bar as the car's own navigation draws them, lanes, rerouting text, and a resend every second. While it has guidance, the official mod's cluster calls in DiPO get its values. Off: the official mod's turn-by-turn as it is.

settings.title: Log the CarPlay turn-by-turn diagnosis
settings.description: Adds Korea Projection's diagnosis lines: the near-turn decision (lanes, distance, D), what was sent to the cluster, lanes, and the navigation app's first name. Numbers otherwise, when they change, a few hundred lines at most per start. With it, the HUD list sent too (up to 300 lines; the official mod logs its own). Off, these are still logged: the maneuver values received (type, side, junction, angle, up to 300 lines), a change of navigation app (both app names) and turn-by-turn cleared. No road or place names either way. Off by default: turn it on to collect a log of a turn-by-turn problem.
